# UniLife Nigeria

> Nigeria's all-in-one campus super-app for university students.

## What is UniLife?
UniLife is a verified platform connecting Nigerian university students with scholarships, campus innovation challenges (including OOU), a student marketplace, hostel accommodation, and peer communities.

## Key sections
- [Scholarships](https://unilife.com.ng/scholarships): Verified student scholarships and tuition grants.
- [Challenges](https://unilife.com.ng/challenge): Campus innovation challenges and OOU challenge.
- [Marketplace / Sellers](https://unilife.com.ng/sellers): Buy and sell campus items with zero commission.
- [Students](https://unilife.com.ng/students): Campus life, study groups, communities.
- [FAQ](https://unilife.com.ng/faq): Answers on verification, safety, and features.

## Target audience
Nigerian university students looking for scholarships, campus communities, marketplace, and study tools.
